summary: Adopter guide for isolated ephemeral self-hosted runners on private repos with explicit security warnings.
migration_impact: Optional reading before registering local runners; import-payload copies the guide into adopting repos.
migration_guidance: 1. Read docs/migration/self-hosted-runners.md before registering any self-hosted runner.
2. Keep fork and outside-contributor workflows on GitHub-hosted runs-on only.
3. Run gh plate runner for the doc path and planned CLI subcommands (#1212).
agent_notes: Never register runners on public repos. Personal GitHub accounts need one runner registration per private repo or a free org for sharing.
